Overview & City Profile

Oviedo (Oviedo (Province of Asturias)) is a municipality in Province of Asturias, Asturias (coordinates 43.358°N, -5.8734°E; population 225,973). Visitors use Oviedo as a base to explore Asturias's historic town centers, regional markets, and culinary specialties such as Tapas & raciones, Jamón Ibérico de Bellota, Tortilla Española.

Within Asturias Region (Province of Asturias region), Oviedo (Oviedo (Province of Asturias)) serves as a municipio (municipality) in asturias region. Travelers exploring Asturias often combine a stop in Oviedo with regional highlights such as Casco Histórico & Plaza Mayor, Cathedral & Alcázar, Traditional Mercado Central, Evening Paseo & tapas quarter.

Getting to Oviedo & Getting Around

Via the regional hub (Gijón/Xixón Central Station (Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail)): Connected via Renfe AVE / Avlo / Ouigo / Iryo high-speed rail and ALSA intercity coaches.

  • Local rail & IC cards: Once in Asturias Region, JR regional lines and local private railways connect Gijón/Xixón with Oviedo. Nationwide IC cards (Transit Card, Pasmo, Icoca) work on major urban and JR commuter gates; for rural branch lines or local buses, keep €1,000 bills and €100 coins handy for the onboard fare box.
  • Luggage & station lockers: Main stations in Asturias have coin lockers for day-trippers. If you are stopping in Oviedo en route between larger bases, check your suitcase dimensions in our Luggage & Locker Checker or forward big bags ahead with Takkyubin.
  • Driving & car rental: While city centers around Oviedo are accessible by train and taxi, renting a car from a major Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail station or airport in Asturias can be rewarding for reaching mountain gorges, coastal viewpoints, and countryside onsen. Read our Renting a Car in Spain Guide.

Best Time to Visit & Seasonal Highlights

Best time to visit Asturias: Apr–Jun, Sep–Nov.

Regional highlights across Asturias Region that pair well with a visit to Oviedo include: Casco Histórico & Plaza Mayor, Cathedral & Alcázar, Traditional Mercado Central, Evening Paseo & tapas quarter.

Practical Travel Tips for Oviedo

  • Tourist information center (観光案内所): Look for the Kankō Annaijo counter inside or right outside the main train station in Oviedo (or at Gijón/Xixón Central Station (Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail)) for free walking maps, bus timetables, and festival calendars.
  • Cash & ATMs: While hotels, chain stores, and convenience stores in Oviedo accept international cards and IC payment, smaller family-run restaurants, shrines, and rural buses often prefer cash. 7-Eleven (Seven Bank) and Spain Post ATMs accept foreign debit cards reliably.
  • Dining hours: Outside major metropolitan hubs, lunch typically runs 11:30 AM–2:00 PM and dinner spots open around 5:30 PM, with earlier last orders (around 8:00–9:00 PM) in smaller cities.

Frequently asked questions

Where is Oviedo (Oviedo (Province of Asturias)) located in Spain?

Oviedo (Oviedo (Province of Asturias)) is a municipio (municipality) located in Asturias Region in the Province of Asturias region of Spain (coordinates: 43.358°N, -5.8734°E). It has a population of approximately 225,973 across an area of Regional km².

How do I get to Oviedo by train?

Most visitors reach Oviedo via the main prefectural gateway of Gijón/Xixón Central Station (Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail). Connected via Renfe AVE / Avlo / Ouigo / Iryo high-speed rail and ALSA intercity coaches. From the regional hub, connect by JR local/rapid lines, private commuter railways, or local bus to Oviedo. You can estimate long-distance rail costs using our Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail Fare Calculator.

What local food is Oviedo and Asturias known for?

In Oviedo and across Asturias Region, top local dishes include Tapas & raciones, Jamón Ibérico de Bellota, Tortilla Española, as well as Churros con chocolate and Regional DO wines. Look for local ekiben (station bento boxes), morning markets, and family-run shokudo near the main station.

When is the best time of year to visit Oviedo?

Best time to visit Asturias: Apr–Jun, Sep–Nov. Check our Spain Seasonal Calendar to compare month-by-month weather and crowd levels.
